_README: Edit this file to update business details site-wide. Any value left empty ("") is hidden on the public site, never faked. After editing, redeploy (Netlify rebuilds automatically when connected to Git, or run: python3 build.py).
_site_url_note: CONFIRM: you wrote 'blue route.us.com'. Domains cannot contain spaces, so this assumes blueroute.us.com. Change it if your domain is different (e.g. blue-route.us.com).
_legal_name_note: Exact name on your Florida LLC filing, e.g. 'Blue Route Logistics LLC'. Used in the Privacy Policy, Terms and copyright line.
_phone_note: phone_display is what visitors see, e.g. '(772) 555-0100'. phone_e164 is the same number for tap-to-call, e.g. '+17725550100'.
_email_note: Public business email, e.g. dispatch@blueroute.us.com. Also set the same address for form notifications in Netlify.

analytics._note: Optional privacy-friendly analytics. Set to your domain (e.g. blueroute.us.com) after creating a Plausible account. Leave empty for no analytics.

_google_site_verification_note: Only needed if you verify Search Console with the HTML-tag method. DNS verification (recommended) doesn't need this.
_policy_effective_date_note: Date your Privacy Policy and Terms take effect, e.g. 'January 5, 2027'. Have both reviewed by a Florida attorney before launch.

_testimonials_example.quote: Real customer quote goes here, used only with written permission.
_testimonials_example.name: Customer name

_testimonials_note: The testimonial section stays hidden until at least one entry has "approved": true. Add only genuine feedback you have written permission to publish.
